question: Should OpenClaw adopt the role-based memory slot API from the linked implementation, keep one recommended memory slot, or choose a narrower plugin API for the affected memory roles?
rationale: The issue asks for new public config/plugin API surface that VISION.md treats as a product direction tradeoff, and the live candidate PR has compatibility and migration implications that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Adopt role slots through the linked PR
options.body: Review the linked PR's compatibility proof and land a role-slot contract if maintainers agree this is the memory architecture OpenClaw should expose.

options.title: Keep one memory slot
options.body: Close or narrow the request if maintainers want memory plugins to converge on one recommended default path rather than expose multiple simultaneous roles.

options.title: Request a narrower plugin seam
options.body: Ask for a smaller API that solves the concrete Honcho/dreaming/coexistence gaps without adding the full role taxonomy yet.

recommendation.title: Adopt role slots through the linked PR
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR's compatibility proof and land a role-slot contract if maintainers agree this is the memory architecture OpenClaw should expose.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the memory slot surface and recent plugin activation helpers that the public API decision would change.
